buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address 21 Assam Rifles Vijaynagar Helipad Changlang Arunachal Pradesh 792 055 . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work The work shall include complete construction of the passenger waiting shed as per approved drawings, BO Q, technical specifications and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge. The scope shall include all civil, stru ctural, roofing, flooring, electrical, painting, drainage and other allied works necessary for satisfactory com pletion and handing over of the facility. 2. Site Inspection The contractor shall inspect the site and satisfy himself regarding site conditions, access, availability of wo rking space, existing structures/services and other site constraints before quoting the rates. No additional payment shall ordinarily be admissible on account of failure to inspect the site. 3. Drawings and Specifications All works shall be executed strictly in accordance with the approved drawings, BOQ and technical specifica tions. In case of discrepancies, the decision of the Engineer-in-Charge shall be final, subject to the provisio ns of the contract. 4. Materials All materials shall be new, unused and of approved quality. Cement, reinforcement steel, structural steel,

roofing sheets, tiles, electrical materials, paint and other materials shall conform to the relevant BIS/IS sta ndards and specifications mentioned in the tender. 5. Approval of Materials Samples of important materials shall be submitted to the Engineer-in-Charge for approval before procurem ent and installation. The Engineer-in-Charge may reject materials that donot conform to the specified quali ty. 6. Concrete and Reinforcement Work RCC work, reinforcement, foundations, columns, beams and slabs shall be executed as per approved struc tural drawings and relevant IS codes. Proper cover, reinforcement placement, form work, vibration and cur ing shall be ensured. 7. Structural Steel Work Structural steel members, trusses, columns, brackets and other fabricated components shall be of approv ed section and quality. Fabrication, welding, bolting, erection and protective coating shall be carried out as per approved drawings and applicable standards. 8. Roofing Roofing shall be provided with the specified material and thickness. Roof sheets shall be properly fixed wit h suitable fasteners, washers and accessories. Adequate slope shall be maintained for effective drainage o f rainwater. 9. Flooring Flooring shall be provided as specified in the BOQ/drawings. The finished floor shall be level, even, properl y compacted and free from cracks, hollows or other defects. 10. Drainage and Rainwater Disposal Proper roof gutters, down pipes and surface drainage arrangements shall be provided wherever specified. Rainwater shall be discharged safely without causing water logging around the waiting shed. 11. Seating Arrangement Benches/seating arrangements, if included in the BOQ, shall be firmly anchored and finished properly. Mat erials and dimensions shall conform to the approved drawings/specifications. 12. Electrical Works Electrical works, where included, shall comprise wiring, conduits, switches, lights, fans and other accessori es as specified. All electrical installations shall comply with applicable electrical safety requirements and r elevant standards. 13. Painting and Finishing All surfaces shall be properly prepared before painting. Primer, putty and finishing coats shall be applied a s specified. The final finish shall be uniform, clean and free from peeling, patches and visible defects. 14. Quality Control and Testing The contractor shall arrange all necessary tests of materials and completed works as directed by the Engin eer-in-Charge. Test reports/certificates shall be submitted whenever required. 15. Workmanship The contractor shall deploy adequately skilled and experienced workers. All workmanship shall be of good quality and in accordance with accepted engineering practice and the specifications. 16. Safety at Site The contractor shall provide necessary barricading, warning signs, PPE, safe access and other safety arran gements. Workers shall use appropriate helmets, safety shoes, gloves, safety belts and other PPE whereve r required.

17. Protection of Public Since the facility is intended for passenger/public use, the contractor shall take adequateprecautions to pr event injury or inconvenience to passengers and other persons using thesurrounding area. 18. Protection of Existing Services Existing electrical lines, water pipelines, communication cables, roads, drains and other services shall be p rotected during execution. Any damage caused due to the contractor’s operations shall be repaired/reinst ated at his own cost. 19. Site Cleanliness Construction debris, surplus materials, excavated earth and waste shall be removed regularly. The site sha ll be maintained in a clean and safe condition throughout the execution period. 20. Measurement and Payment Measurement and payment shall be made strictly according to the applicable units and quantities specifie d in the BOQ and as actually executed and accepted by the Engineer-in-Charge. 21. Completion Period The entire work shall be completed within the stipulated period mentioned in the NIT/Work Order. The cont ractor shall arrange sufficient manpower, materials, tools and machinery to maintain the required progres s. 22. Defective Work Any defective or substandard work identified during execution or before completion shall be rectified/repla ced by the contractor at his own cost to the satisfaction of the Engineer-in-Charge. 23. Warranty/Defect Liability The contractor shall remain responsible for rectification of defects during the applicable defect liability peri od as stipulated in the contract (03 years). Structural, workmanship or material defects attributable to the contractor shall be rectified without additional cost. 24. Statutory Requirements The contractor shall comply with all applicable labour, safety, environmental, taxation and other statutory requirements relevant to execution of the work. 25. Labour Regulations The contractor shall comply with applicable labour laws and regulations and shall be responsible for wages , welfare, safety and other statutory obligations concerning his workers. 26. Insurance and Liability The contractor shall maintain such insurance and assume such liabilities as required under the applicable GCC and tender conditions. 27. No Subletting The contractor shall not assign or sublet the whole or any substantial part of the work except with the prior written approval of the competent authority and as permitted under the contract. 28. Engineer-in-Charge’s Instructions The contractor shall comply with lawful instructions issued by the Engineer-in-Charge concerning quality, workmanship, safety, sequencing and execution of the work. 29. Completion and Handing Over On completion, the contractor shall clean the entire facility, remove temporary installations and debris, re ctify all defects and hand over the passenger waiting shed in a complete and usable condition. 30. Applicable GCC and Specifications

All other conditions not specifically covered under these ATC clauses shall be governed by the applicable General Conditions of Contract (GCC), technical specifications, drawings, BOQ and amendments/corrigenda issued by the competent authority. CPWD maintains separate current publications and amendments for co nstruction-work GCC and technical specifications. .
